# A raw pointer operand `ld hl|de|bc, $Dxxx` is banked WRAM: the same address is another variable in every bank.  It is written as the name of ram/banked.asm for the bank of the rule when the routine that receives the

# register dereferences it in that bank.  The consumer is the first call/farcall/tail jp of the straight line after the load, with only plain instructions that do not touch the register in between (a write of a bank register

# may lie between the load and the call: the bank at the call counts), or the pseudo consumer `(direct)` (needs `switch` only): the first instruction that uses the register dereferences it (it may sit behind a bank switch and
# behind a loop head that keeps the bank; a loop that walks past the end of the object is `overrun` and stays numeric).

# needs: `-` the routine selects the bank itself; `fixed` the bank is a property of the code and not of its caller (the mail library: invariant L5 in the proof of the row); `switch` the caller does, and the tool must find the bank

# idiom (`ld a, $0N / ldh [hWRAMBank], a / ldh [rSVBK], a`, or a call that sets the bank: analysis/naming2/wramx_calls.tsv) of that bank earlier in the straight line, the scan crossing a local label only when every way into it

# shows the same bank; `a` the routine takes the bank of the pointer in A: the constant in A at the call must be the bank, or 0 for a consumer that the effects file lists as `keeps if A=0`, with the idiom showing the bank;

# `dest` the bank is the constant stored in hTextTiles_DestBank (the nearest store, scanning back from the consumer call: it may lie between the load and the call).  bank `*` = the bank that the proof shows (any of W1-W7;

# refused with needs `-` or `fixed`).  With --observed a `switch` row, and an `a` row with A = 0, may also be proven by the replays of the consumer or dereference instruction (one bank only, no contradiction with the idiom).

# family: a regular expression the chosen name must match (a rule is about one kind of object).  The name states the bank in which the consumer dereferences the pointer; the caller's own bank may be another one.
